Hugging Face Trending Models Digest 2026-09-17

Source: Hugging Face Hub | 30 models | Generated: 2026-09-17 02:13 UTC

Hugging Face Trending Models Digest

Date: September 17, 2026

1. Today's Highlights

As of September 17, 2026, Qwen’s 3.8-series multimodal models dominate Hugging Face’s weekly trending charts, with the base Qwen3.8-27B leading all entries at 15,407 likes and 7.67 million downloads, supported by a sprawling ecosystem of community quantizations and fine-tunes. Generative video models see surging momentum, with Lightricks’ LTX-2.5 and MiniMaxAI’s MiniMax-H3 ranking among the top 10 most-liked entries, driven by demand for high-fidelity, open-weight video creation tools. Chinese open-weight model families account for 60% of the top 30 trending list, including entries from DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax, reflecting their growing global adoption as alternatives to Western open models. Small-footprint agentic LLMs, such as TokenRhythm’s NeoHorse-1-4B and Edge0’s edge-optimized MoE, also gain traction as developers prioritize lightweight, tool-use capable models for on-device deployments.

2. Trending Models

🧠 Language Models (LLMs, chat models, instruction-tuned)

  • Edge0/Edge0-35B-A3B-preview Author: Edge0 | Likes: 3,111 | Downloads: 27,759 A 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) text generation model optimized for edge inference, trending for its balance of performance and on-device efficiency built on the Qwen 3.5 MoE architecture.
  • openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B Author: openbmb | Likes: 1,506 | Downloads: 324,322 A compact 2B-parameter LLaMA-based text generation model, trending for its strong performance in local deployments and high download volume among small-footprint open LLMs.
  • nex-agi/Nex-N2.5-mini Author: nex-agi | Likes: 820 | Downloads: 6,837 A lightweight MoE text generation model with multimodal support, trending for its agent-focused design and compatibility with Qwen 3.5 MoE tooling.
  • TokenRhythm/NeoHorse-1-4B Author: TokenRhythm | Likes: 2,116 | Downloads: 16,163 A 4B-parameter agentic text generation model built on Qwen 3.5, trending for its optimized tool-use and autonomous workflow capabilities.
  • XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B Author: XHToken | Likes: 1,234 | Downloads: 27,191 A 4B-parameter open LLM for general text generation, trending as a compact, high-performing option for consumer-grade hardware deployments.
  • openai-community/gpt2 Author: openai-community | Likes: 4,119 | Downloads: 15,584,259 The classic 124M-parameter foundational text generation model from OpenAI, trending due to its enduring use as a baseline for research, prototyping, and educational purposes.
  • meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Author: meta-llama | Likes: 7,658 | Downloads: 5,861,705 Meta’s 8B-parameter instruction-tuned chat LLM, trending as a widely adopted benchmark for open chat model performance and a popular base for community fine-tuning.

🎨 Multimodal & Generation (image, video, audio, text-to-X)

  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Author: deepseek-ai | Likes: 2,865 | Downloads: 366,459 A high-speed multimodal (image-text-to-text) model from DeepSeek, trending for its fast inference and strong vision-language reasoning performance.
  • m-a-p/YuE2-3B Author: m-a-p | Likes: 645 | Downloads: 9,391 A 3B-parameter text-to-audio music generation model with symbolic planning and agentic editing capabilities, trending as a novel open option for controllable music creation.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B Author: Qwen | Likes: 15,407 | Downloads: 7,667,556 Qwen’s flagship 27B-parameter multimodal (image-text-to-text) conversational model, trending as the highest-liked entry on the list with massive download volume for vision-language tasks.
  • Lightricks/LTX-2.5 Author: Lightricks | Likes: 4,115 | Downloads: 1,616,663 A state-of-the-art image-to-video diffusion model supporting text-to-video and video-to-video workflows, trending for its high-fidelity output and single-file diffusion format.
  • tencent/AuK Author: tencent | Likes: 270 | Downloads: 2,753 A zero-shot text-to-speech model with voice cloning capabilities from Tencent, trending as a new open audio option for high-quality custom voice generation.
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 Author: MiniMaxAI | Likes: 5,381 | Downloads: 4,689,062 A high-performance image-text-to-video generation model from MiniMax, trending for its near-commercial quality output and widespread adoption in creative AI workflows.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Author: Qwen | Likes: 5,312 | Downloads: 689,347 An experimental fast-inference multimodal (image-text-to-text) conversational model from Qwen’s 3.8 series, trending as a preview of next-generation efficient vision-language architectures.
  • Agnes-AI/Agnes-3.0-Flash Author: Agnes-AI | Likes: 199 | Downloads: 1,063 A lightweight fast-inference multimodal (image-text-to-text) model, trending as a new open entry in the efficient vision-language model space.
  • zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash Author: zai-org | Likes: 2,393 | Downloads: 2,244,085 A fast, conversational multimodal (image-text-to-text) model from the GLM family, trending for its strong performance and high download volume among Chinese open VLMs.
  • TaichuAI/ZDTaichu5.0-9B Author: TaichuAI | Likes: 154 | Downloads: 213 A 9B-parameter multimodal (image-text-to-text) model optimized for spatial reasoning, trending as a specialized new VLM for spatial understanding tasks.

🔧 Specialized Models (code, math, medical, embeddings)

  • sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Author: sentence-transformers | Likes: 6,024 | Downloads: 256,481,161 A lightweight, high-performance sentence embedding model for semantic similarity tasks, trending as the most downloaded model on the list due to its ubiquitous use in retrieval, RAG, and NLP pipelines.
  • google-bert/bert-base-uncased Author: google-bert | Likes: 3,354 | Downloads: 47,693,504 Google’s foundational 110M-parameter masked language model, trending due to its enduring role as a standard encoder for fine-tuning across a wide range of downstream NLP tasks.
  • facebook/mms-300m Author: facebook | Likes: 554 | Downloads: 22,119 Meta’s 300M-parameter multilingual speech pretraining model from the Massively Multilingual Speech project, trending for its support of low-resource languages and speech-related downstream tasks.
  • openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 Author: openai | Likes: 1,547 | Downloads: 21,790,053 OpenAI’s CLIP ViT-B/32 zero-shot image-text classification model, trending as a core utility for image retrieval, multimodal embedding, and computer vision pipelines.
  • distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased Author: distilbert | Likes: 1,459 | Downloads: 7,410,664 A distilled, smaller, faster version of BERT-base-uncased with 97% of its performance, trending as a go-to efficient encoder for production NLP deployments.

📦 Fine-tunes & Quantizations (community fine-tunes, GGUF, AWQ)

  • ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF Author: ISTA-DASLab | Likes: 1,196 | Downloads: 956,964 A GGUF-quantized version of Qwen3.8-27B using GSQ-RCO mixed-precision quantization, trending for its ability to run the high-performance VLM on consumer hardware with minimal quality loss.
  • DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NEO-CODER-MAX-MTP-GGUF Author: DavidAU | Likes: 796 | Downloads: 1,049,586 A heavily fine-tuned, uncensored GGUF quant of Qwen3.8-27B optimized for coding and creative writing, trending for its feature-rich merge and high download volume among community Qwen variants.
  • unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Author: unsloth | Likes: 4,221 | Downloads: 8,856,150 The official Unsloth GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B, trending as the most downloaded Qwen3.8 variant, optimized for fast local and edge deployment of the multimodal model.
  • ukisai/Swift-Qwen3.8-27b Author: ukisai | Likes: 332 | Downloads: 2,753 A community fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B optimized for efficient thinking and fast inference, trending as a high-speed variant of the popular multimodal model.
  • WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity Author: WarmBloodAban | Likes: 452 | Downloads: 164,451 A community fine-tune of MiniMax-H3 optimized for enhanced video generation quality, trending for its improved output fidelity across text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video tasks.
  • dealignai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-UNCENSORED-FP8 Author: dealignai | Likes: 231 | Downloads: 6,826 An uncensored, FP8-quantized fine-tune of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, trending for users seeking unfiltered multimodal generation capabilities with fast inference.
  • ukisai/Swift-Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Author: ukisai | Likes: 183 | Downloads: 55,309 The GGUF-quantized version of the Swift-Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune, trending for its combination of efficient thinking capabilities and local deployment compatibility.
  • Comfy-Org/YuE2 Author: Comfy-Org | Likes: 152 | Downloads: 59,231 A ComfyUI-optimized fine-tune of the m-a-p SheetSage2/YuE2 music generation model, trending for its easy integration into popular creative AI workflows.

3. Ecosystem Signal

Qwen’s 3.8-series multimodal model family is the clear momentum leader in this week’s trending list, with 7 total entries including the highest-liked base model (Qwen3.8-27B, 15.4k likes) and 5 community quantizations/fine-tunes, underscoring its rapid adoption as a new standard for open vision-language models. Chinese open-weight model families (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax) account for 60% of the top 30, outpacing Western open models like Meta’s Llama 3.1 in new release velocity, as global users prioritize their strong performance and permissive access. Open-weight models dominate entirely, with no proprietary API-only entries, reflecting a broader shift toward local and self-hosted deployments. Quantization activity is heavily concentrated on Qwen3.8 variants, with GGUF versions (notably the Unsloth quant, 8.86M downloads) outpacing base model downloads, while community fine-tunes focused on uncensored output, coding, and efficient thinking see strong traction.

4. Worth Exploring

  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: As the highest-liked entry on the trending list with 7.67 million downloads, this 27B-parameter multimodal model has quickly emerged as a new open standard for vision-language tasks. Its robust conversational performance, paired with an extensive ecosystem of community quantizations and fine-tunes optimized for every deployment use case, makes it invaluable for both production integration and multimodal research.
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3: This open image-text-to-video model delivers near-commercial generation quality and supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video workflows. With 4.69 million downloads and active community fine-tuning (including the trending Singularity variant), it is one of the most capable open video generation models available, ideal for creative AI experimentation and production pipeline testing.
  • m-a-p/YuE2-3B: A standout in text-to-audio generation, it integrates symbolic planning and agentic editing for highly controllable music creation, filling a gap in open generative audio models that typically lack granular iterative control. For researchers and developers building AI music tools, its open weights and unique agentic editing framework offer a flexible foundation for next-generation generative audio workflows.
